# Post-Processing Requirements Checklist: Splat Cleanup And SOG Compression

**Purpose**: Validate that cleanup, merge, SOG, dependency, and resume requirements are complete and precise before task generation  
**Created**: 2026-06-15  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are source-selection requirements defined for both completed `splat_finished.ply` outputs and incomplete iteration-stamped outputs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005]

- [x] CHK003 Are cleanup output requirements defined for every eligible patch, including selected source, status, warnings, timing, and before/after counts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK004 Are merge input requirements defined for every patch considered, including included/excluded status and incomplete-source severity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK005 Are final output requirements defined for both the merged cleaned site PLY and final SOG output? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-020, Contracts §post-processing-artifacts]
- [x] CHK006 Are public-config safety requirements defined for example configs, specs, and docs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "highest-iteration usable patch PLY" sufficiently defined to avoid ambiguity when multiple incomplete files exist? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Data Model §PatchTrainingSource]
- [x] CHK008 Are the 80 percent warning thresholds stated with enough precision to classify boundary values consistently? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-007]

- [x] CHK014 Are spec and contracts consistent that SOG export failure after a valid merge produces partial post-processing status while preserving the merged PLY? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023, Contracts §cli, Contracts §run-records]
- [x] CHK015 Are config defaults in the config contract consistent with the evidenced coral cleanup defaults listed in the spec assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Contracts §config-schema]
